coverage.member: FusionCarousel(#if NET48 this HtmlHelper<TModel> html, #else this IHtmlHelper<TModel> html, #endif ReactivePlan<TModel> plan, string elementId, Action<CarouselBuilder> build)
coverage.catches: the FusionCarousel render helper stops rendering the carousel bound to its slides (the test asserts the review opens with the Medications section visible as the active slide)
the SelectedIndex() read stops yielding the carousel's current index (the DomReady reaction reads it to set the position line; the test asserts it reads 'Section 1 of 3: Medications' on open)
Next() stops advancing the carousel one slide (the test clicks Next and asserts the active slide becomes Therapy Goals)
the .Reactive wiring stops connecting the carousel's slideChanged event to its plan pipeline, so advancing runs no reaction and neither the status nor the chart updates
the slideChanged event selector stops firing the after-change reaction when a slide changes, so the section text and chart line never update after Next

the slideChanged event-arg contract stops delivering the change payload into the plan, so the gathered chart line cannot be built (the test asserts the chart records 'moved forward to Therapy Goals (from Medications), using the buttons')
SlideChanged.CurrentIndex stops carrying the index of the section just reached (the test asserts the 'Now reviewing' line reads Therapy Goals after advancing from Medications)
Previous() stops moving the carousel back one slide (the test advances to Discharge Steps then clicks Previous and asserts the active slide returns to Therapy Goals)
SlideChanged.PreviousIndex stops carrying the index of the section the resident came from (the test steps back from Discharge Steps and asserts the line reads 'after the discharge steps')
SlideChanged.SlideDirection stops reporting the move direction (the test steps back and asserts the movement line reads 'You went back a section.', the Previous branch of the direction condition)

SlideChanged.IsSwiped stops distinguishing a button move (false) from a swipe (the test reaches a section with the buttons and asserts both the on-screen 'Reached using the navigation buttons.' and the chart's 'using the buttons')

the slideChanging event selector stops firing the before-change guard, so a backward move onto the locked medications section is never intercepted (the test asserts the lock notice appears and the carousel stays put)
the slideChanging event-arg contract stops delivering the pending-change payload into the plan, so the guard cannot read the move or cancel it
SlideChanging.NextIndex stops carrying the index the move would land on, so the NextIndex==0 guard cannot recognize a move onto the medications section and the lock never engages

PreventTransition() stops cancelling the pending move, so the backward step onto medications is NOT blocked (the test asserts the carousel stays on Therapy Goals and the position stays 'Section 2 of 3')
the writable Cancel payload field stops taking effect when PreventTransition sets it true, so the cancelled transition still happens (the test asserts the carousel never leaves Therapy Goals)
SlideChanging.CurrentIndex stops carrying the section the resident is leaving from (the test asserts the gate reads 'You are still on the therapy goals section.', the CurrentIndex==1 branch)
SlideChanging.SlideDirection stops reporting the attempted direction (the test asserts the gate reads 'You tried to go back to the medications section.', the Previous branch)
SlideChanging.IsSwiped stops distinguishing the blocked gesture as a button press (false) from a swipe (the test asserts the gate reads 'That button press was not applied.')

acceptedFanout.reason: One user gesture (clicking Next) with DISTINCT fails-when-broken assertions per member: the active slide becoming Therapy Goals (Next), the 'Now reviewing Therapy Goals' line (SlideChanged.CurrentIndex), the position line updating (SelectedIndex re-read, asserted in this and the open test), and the chart line being built and shown (Reactive wiring connecting it / SlideChanged firing / FusionCarouselSlideChangedArgs delivering the payload). Each member has its own assertion in this test, not one assertion claimed for many members.

One user gesture (clicking Previous onto the locked first section) with DISTINCT fails-when-broken assertions per member of the before-change guard: the carousel NOT moving (PreventTransition + Cancel, asserted by the active slide staying Therapy Goals and the position staying 'Section 2 of 3'), the guard firing at all (SlideChanging / FusionCarouselSlideChangingArgs, asserted by the lock notice appearing), the guard recognizing the move onto index 0 (NextIndex, the condition that triggers the lock), and three separate gate lines each driven by one distinct payload member: SlideChanging.SlideDirection (gate-direction), SlideChanging.CurrentIndex (gate-from), and SlideChanging.IsSwiped (gate-method). Each member has its own assertion; no single assertion is claimed for multiple members.
